faq.name: Can a royal herald take hits on behalf of a monarch that is engaged in a challenge?
faq.bodyIndex: No.
faq.source: Official Ravening Hordes FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: Heavenly beacon allows you to modify the roll by 1 or 1 when rolling to?
faq.bodyIndex: No, it's not cumulative. You may apply a +1 or -1 modifier if you have one or more Sky Lanterns.
faq.source: Official Armies of Grand Cathay FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.1

faq.name: Can a unit control more than one object on the battlefield for example can a?
faq.bodyIndex: No. If a unit is in a position to control two or more such objects, you must choose one for it to control.
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: If my army includes a mercenary character can i make them my general?
faq.bodyIndex: No. An army’s General must be one of the characters listed in the 'characters' section of the army composition list you are using.
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: Can a steam tanks steam cannon fire grapeshot?
faq.bodyIndex: Yes. Grapeshot can be fired by any cannon (i.e., any weapon that fires using the 'Cannon Fire' special rule), as described on page 226 of the Warhammer: The Old World rulebook.
faq.source: Official Forces of Fantasy FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: For the purposes of other upgrades what types of armour are the armour of silvered steel and the armour of meteoric iron?
faq.bodyIndex: If a suit of magic armour gives an armour value of 6+, it should be considered light armour. If it gives an armour value of 5+, it should be considered heavy armour, and if it gives an armour value of 4+ or better, it should be considered full plate armour.
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: When shooting a cannon a line of sight is required to the target point but what about the strike point?
faq.bodyIndex: A cannon does not require a line of sight to the strike point. However, if anything that would stop a cannonball from bouncing (see 5. Crunch, on page 227) lies between the target point and the strike point, the cannonball will hit it and stop. In other words, you cannot use a high result on the Artillery dice to 'glitch' a cannonball through an impregnable obstacle.
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: If a fanatic moves into contact with a unit thats engaged in combat does it?
faq.bodyIndex: When a Fanatic moves into contact with another unit, it continues in a straight line until it can be placed back on the battlefield. Any units that line passes through are hit. Units the line does not pass through are not hit.
faq.source: Official Ravening Hordes FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: When are line of sight and cover determined for a unit that declares a stand and shoot charge reaction?
faq.bodyIndex: When the charge reaction is declared.
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: If a specific natural roll triggers an effect is that effect still triggered?
faq.bodyIndex: No. When you re-roll a dice, the previous roll is discarded. This includes any effects that roll may have triggered.
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: If i take a black orc warboss as the general of a nomadic waaagh can i take?
faq.bodyIndex: No. A unit of Boar Boys can only be taken as a Core choice if your General is an Orc Warboss.
faq.source: Official Ravening Hordes FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: How does the dark coven army special rule from the wild herd army of infamy?
faq.bodyIndex: In cases such as this, both outcomes can apply. If a natural double is rolled, the spell is cast as a perfect invocation and the caster suffers a hit from the Plague Chalice. However, the caster and any other members of their coven will then also suffer the effects of a roll on the Miscast table, as per the Dark Coven special rule.
faq.source: Official Ravening Hordes FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: Does a unit with the blood greed special rule always roll only a single d6?
faq.bodyIndex: Only whilst Frenzied.
faq.source: Official Ravening Hordes FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: The crew of tomb guard chariots are equipped with shields does this improve?
faq.bodyIndex: No. A chariot's given Armour Value takes into account such equipment.
faq.source: Official Ravening Hordes FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: If a unit upon which earthen ramparts has been cast is obliged to declare a?
faq.bodyIndex: Earthen Ramparts does not prevent a unit from declaring a charge, it prevents it from charging. In other words, yes the unit must declare a charge if obliged to do so. However, because the unit cannot charge, it does not move at all and the charge is failed.
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: Some monsters have weapons with notes that state they must make or may?
faq.bodyIndex: No. If it is noted on a weapon's profile that the model may or must make a specific number of attacks with that weapon, normal attacks or otherwise, that's how many attacks it makes with that weapon.
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: Can a wood elf realms army place an additional wood using the woodland?
faq.bodyIndex: Yes. Note however that an allied contingent of Wood Elves taken as part of another army cannot.
faq.source: Official Forces of Fantasy FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: How do i determine the centre of a unit of skirmishers?
faq.bodyIndex: The centre is the point that is equally distant from the models at the extremities of the group. However, when considering blast templates, the purpose of placing a blast template over the centre of a unit is to ensure a significant number of models are underneath it. In the case of a unit of Skirmishers, this is not always possible. Therefore, you may place the central hole of a blast template over the model closest to the centre of a unit of Skirmishers.
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: Does the martial prowess special rule allow models to make supporting?
faq.bodyIndex: No. Martial Prowess grants the ability to make supporting attacks to the flank or rear, as well as to its front. It does not grant the ability to make supporting attacks to models not normally able to do so.
faq.source: Official Forces of Fantasy FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: Units must make a panic test when a nearby friendly unit with a unit strength of 5 or more is destro?
faq.bodyIndex: From the start of the phase during which the unit was destroyed. For example, if a friendly unit with a Unit Strength of 10 is destroyed by enemy shooting during a single Shooting phase, it causes panic in nearby friendly units. Players are not expected to remember the Unit Strength of every unit from turn to turn or phase to phase, but should keep track of Unit Strength during each phase.
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: If a unit that has dug in becomes engaged in combat does it lose that status?
faq.bodyIndex: No.
faq.source: Official Forces of Fantasy FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: What is the furthest a model can move?
faq.bodyIndex: No model can move more than twice its Movement characteristic or, when movement is determined by a dice roll (such as when a unit charges or flees), further than the distance rolled. There are, of course, exceptions to this, the most obvious being when a unit in Marching Column marches at triple its Movement characteristic, when models are moved by the effect of a spell, when a unit is obliged to continue its move rather than end up 'on top' of another unit, and obligatory moves (such as when a charging unit wheels to align with the enemy, or when a unit pivots before fleeing). Note that when a unit wheels, those at its rear do not really follow a long, curving path, as it might appear when moving a large block of models on the table. In reality, those models would take a more direct route, following the path of the front rank and resuming their formation behind it. Accordingly, we do not measure the distance moved by models in the rear ranks of a wheeling unit. Note also that, when a unit is permitted a free manoeuvre before or after moving, this is free in that it does not count towards the move itself, but the limitation that no model can move more than twice its Movement characteristic applies within the manoeuvre.
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: A unit of empire road wardens may replace its crossbows with braces of?
faq.bodyIndex: No. If the entire unit replaces its crossbows with braces of pistols, that includes the Captain. If the unit is armed with crossbows, the Captain has the option to replace theirs with a brace of pistols or a repeater pistol.
faq.source: Official Forces of Fantasy FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: When deploying armies must units be placed completely within their?
faq.bodyIndex: Yes.
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: Can a character with the shield of the lady special rule retire to the rear?
faq.bodyIndex: No. Once a challenge has been issued and accepted neither combatant can retire until the challenge is resolved. Chivalry demands it.
faq.source: Official Forces of Fantasy FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: When fighting a warriors duel challenge between two unit champions are such?
faq.bodyIndex: No. A Warrior's Duel is fought between the two participants alone, without any support from their units.
faq.source: Official Ravening Hordes FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: Casting the same enchantment or hex spells on a unit more than once has no?
faq.bodyIndex: Unless stated otherwise, such spells are not cumulative and casting them multiple times will have no further effect.
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: If one participant in a challenge causes impact hits or makes stomp attacks?
faq.bodyIndex: Impact Hits are resolved prior to issuing challenges. Stomp Attacks may be directed against the other participant in the challenge.
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: If a units fighting rank is engaged with two enemy units one of which is a?
faq.bodyIndex: Models not engaged in a challenge cannot direct their attacks against models that are. In other words, any models that would normally have to direct their attacks against the character are free to direct them instead against the other unit their unit is engaged with.
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: If a character with the mark of nurgle for example is mounted on a chariot?
faq.bodyIndex: If you want a chariot mount to have the same benefits from a Mark of Chaos that its rider has, you have to pay the points to give the chariot the Mark of Chaos.
faq.source: Official Ravening Hordes FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: Can a unit that rallies and reforms during the rally fleeing units sub phase?
faq.bodyIndex: Yes.
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: Does a weapons ap reduce the armour value of the armour of meteoric iron?
faq.bodyIndex: No.
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: When does a detachment determine which arc of an enemy unit it will charge into when making a supporting charge?
faq.bodyIndex: When it is moved, at the end of the Charge Moves sub-phase.
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: When using domination as a secondary objective do you get the victory points for having more than double the enemys unit strength in a table quarter if there are no enemy models in that quarter?
faq.bodyIndex: No. To be more than double the enemy’s Unit Strength, the enemy has to have some models in the quarter. If they have none and you do, you gain the VP bonus for that achievement instead.
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: Are the effects of eternal taskmaster cumulative?
faq.bodyIndex: No.
faq.source: Official Ravening Hordes FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: Are the effects of the grand cannons thunderous impact special rule?
faq.bodyIndex: No, it's not cumulative.
faq.source: Official Armies of Grand Cathay FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.1

faq.name: Does the daemon heart increase its users dispel range?
faq.bodyIndex: No.
faq.source: Official Ravening Hordes FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: When a model fights must it make all of its attacks or can it choose to make?
faq.bodyIndex: If a model is able to fight, it must make all of its attacks.
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: Can a steam tanks engineer commander and steam cannon both shoot during the?
faq.bodyIndex: Yes. The Engineer Commander doesn't fire the steam cannon, imagine there's a (very hot and bothered) crew hidden away inside the Steam Tank whose endeavours leave the Engineer Commander free to fire their own weapon.
faq.source: Official Forces of Fantasy FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: Does a unit that includes a grail monk with a blessed triptych lose stubborn if the grail monk is killed before the rule can be used?
faq.bodyIndex: No. As per the errata, a unit that includes a Blessed Triptych becomes Stubborn, regardless of whether or not the model that purchased that upgrade has been killed or not.
faq.source: Official Forces of Fantasy FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: Can you choose not to roll for the arrival of ambushers during your start of turn sub phase?
faq.bodyIndex: No. Unless the unit itself or the scenario being played has a special rule that changes the way in which Ambushers arrive, you must roll for their arrival during each of your turns, from round two onwards. However, any special rules that affect the arrival of Ambushers which take effect after the Start of Turn sub-phase but before the Compulsory Moves sub-phase may be used as normal, regardless of the result of the Ambushers roll.
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: Can a model that chooses to stand and shoot or fire and flee as a charge?
faq.bodyIndex: No. As stated on page 143, models that know such spells can attempt to cast them when chosen during the active player's Shooting phase. Perhaps obviously, this includes Bound spells.
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: The bow of loren allows a wood elf character to make a number of shots equal?
faq.bodyIndex: When firing an Enchanted Arrow it is assumed the model is firing only once, as is the norm. Therefore, one of the shots fired from the Bow of Loren can be made using an Enchanted Arrow, the other shots are resolved using ordinary (i.e., not Enchanted) arrows.
faq.source: Official Forces of Fantasy FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: Do magic missiles that require the caster to draw a line from their base require a target?
faq.bodyIndex: No. As stated in the spell's description, simply draw a line from the caster's base. Any model the line hits is hit by the spell.
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: Is an entrenched unit protected on all four sides or just its front?
faq.bodyIndex: Just its front, as stated on page 270 of the Warhammer: the Old World rulebook.
faq.source: Official Forces of Fantasy FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: Can a model armed with two hand weapons choose to fight with just one hand?
faq.bodyIndex: Yes. As noted on page 213, unless stated otherwise, all models are assumed to be equipped with a hand weapon. A model with two has, by definition, two and may choose to fight with just one, foregoing the Extra Attacks (+1) special rule in favour of some other benefit.
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: In a nomadic waaagh i can take one black orc boss per black orc chariot if i?
faq.bodyIndex: No. You can take one Black Orc Boss per Black Orc Chariot taken as a Core or Rare choice. It does not matter what the Boss is mounted on.
faq.source: Official Ravening Hordes FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: If a unit that is subject to any leadership modifiers uses the generals?
faq.bodyIndex: No, the modifier will still apply. For example, if a unit loses a round of combat to a Terror causing enemy, the -1 modifier to Leadership caused by Terror applies to whichever Leadership characteristic the unit makes its Break test against, be that its own or that of a nearby character.
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: Can a cannon that is on a hill target a point on the ground if woods a building or a hill lies between it and that point?
faq.bodyIndex: No, a cannon cannot shoot over such obstacles, even if it is on a hill. However, a stone thrower can if it chooses to fire indirectly.
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: Sometimes when a unit of skirmishers charges or is charged some of the?
faq.bodyIndex: The unit loses coherency, as described on page 184. This means models belonging to the unit must be removed from play as casualties until the unit becomes coherent.
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: If i mark the position of a unit then proceed to move it before putting it?
faq.bodyIndex: Yes, absolutely.
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: Can a royal champion in a unit of hammerers put weapon runes on their great?
faq.bodyIndex: No. Weapon runes can only be inscribed upon a hand weapon or great weapon, as defined in the Warhammer: the Old World rulebook. The Royal Clan Warriors' gromril great axes and the Hammerers' great hammers are unique types of weapon, each with their own profile and rules.
faq.source: Official Forces of Fantasy FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: If one participant in a challenge is killed can other models engaged in the?
faq.bodyIndex: No. Even if one participant in a challenge has been slain, the challenge is considered to be ongoing until the end of the current Combat phase.
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: How are victory points scored for a night goblin unit that includes one or?
faq.bodyIndex: Fanatics are an upgrade for the unit; their cost is included when working out VP for the unit itself. In other words, the death of an individual Fanatic is not worth any VP, but destroying the unit it was concealed within will earn you the VP for the Fanatic as part of the unit's points cost.
faq.source: Official Ravening Hordes FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: If a character joins a unit of skin wolves can they be transfigured by the?
faq.bodyIndex: No.
faq.source: Official Ravening Hordes FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: Can a unit upon which earthen ramparts has been cast make a counter charge?
faq.bodyIndex: No.
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: Can a necrosphinx make more than one attack each turn with its decapitating?
faq.bodyIndex: No. The decapitating strike profile must be used as noted – to make one additional attack.
faq.source: Official Ravening Hordes FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: Mastery of the elemental winds can only be used once per turn but is this?
faq.bodyIndex: Once per army.
faq.source: Official Armies of Grand Cathay FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.1

faq.name: Models in a fighting rank cannot fight if they are killed before they have a?
faq.bodyIndex: Yes. Unless they have been killed, models that are in a fighting rank or that are able to make supporting attacks can do so as normal. In other words, casualties inflicted reduce, firstly, the number of models in the fighting rank(s) that are able to fight (starting with the first fighting rank) and, secondly, the number of models in the 'supporting rank' that are able to fight.
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: Can a unit with defensive stakes be hit by impact hits or stomp attacks by a?
faq.bodyIndex: Yes. Whilst the stakes might do tremendous damage to 'cavalry' and 'chariots', the momentum of such models when they charge will carry them into the archers, although they may be turned to kindling in the attempt.
faq.source: Official Forces of Fantasy FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: When a model hits an enemy unit using the deathblow special rule?
faq.bodyIndex: Yes.
faq.source: Official Forces of Fantasy FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: Bearing two or more obsidian lodestones gives better magic resistance but?
faq.bodyIndex: No.
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: Does an allied contingent have to abide by the restrictions given in the?
faq.bodyIndex: Yes. An allied contingent is a small army within a large army, made using a Grand Army or Army of Infamy composition list. Within a 2,000 points army, for example, an allied contingent of 500 points would have to spend at least 125 points on Core units, could spend no more than 250 points on characters, and would be unable to include any units limited to 0-1 per 1,000 points.
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: Can a cannon target a point on the ground if another unit lies between it and that point?
faq.bodyIndex: Not unless that cannon is on a hill and the unit is not. However, as above, a stone thrower can if it chooses to fire indirectly.
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: Before a steam tank charges can it use the steam power special rule to?
faq.bodyIndex: No. The Steam Power special rule can be used by a Steam Tanks, a model that cannot march, instead of marching. In other words, in instances where most models or units would increase their movement by marching, a Steam Tank can instead make use of the Steam Power special rule. Charging is not such an instance.
faq.source: Official Forces of Fantasy FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: If my battle standard bearer refuses a challenge and retires from combat can?
faq.bodyIndex: Not whilst that character's unit is still engaged with the model that issued the challenge. Battle standards are somewhat less inspirational whilst being used as a blanket to hide beneath.
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: Does the armour bane x special rule apply to spells cast by a model with the?
faq.bodyIndex: No.
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: If a wizard has a special rule that applies when they attack an enemy such as killing blow or armour bane is that special rule applied to any spells they may cast?
faq.bodyIndex: Absolutely not.
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: How does a unit of skirmishers form up when charged by two or more different?
faq.bodyIndex: The Skirmishers should form up against the first charging unit to move into contact with them. The remaining enemy units then charge the formed Skirmishers. If any units are unable to complete their charge moves, their charges are failed.
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: Can a black orc boss take a black orc chariot as a mount in an army made?
faq.bodyIndex: They cannot. With heavy hearts, we must inform everyone who asked that that option is only available in armies made using the Nomadic Waaagh! Army of Infamy composition list.
faq.source: Official Ravening Hordes FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: Can a missile weapon be used in combat?
faq.bodyIndex: No.
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: Can a model use a breath weapon after marching?
faq.bodyIndex: No. A model cannot shoot during the Shooting phase if it marched during the preceding Movement phase and, although they work differently to most missile weapons, Breath weapons are a type of missile weapon.
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: If a unit charges an enemy unit upon which earthen ramparts has been cast?
faq.bodyIndex: Yes. A unit upon which Earthen Ramparts has been cast counts as being behind a defended low linear obstacle when charged. Think of the spell’s effect as representing a magically manifested obstacle between, rather than a physical terrain feature.
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: What happens if a hit is rolled on the scatter dice for an object that moves?
faq.bodyIndex: Essentially, objects that move in a random direction scatter, as described on page 95. Such objects only move in the direction shown by the small arrow on the Hit icon if the rules tell you they do so. Otherwise, the object does not move.
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: Is overkill counted by or against a champion in a challenge or does it only?
faq.bodyIndex: Overkill counts in all challenges, whether the participants are characters or champions.
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: Can a unit move whilst locked in combat?
faq.bodyIndex: No.
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: What happens to a fanatic that moves into or through the front arc of a unit?
faq.bodyIndex: Nothing good. Defensive stakes function very much like linear terrain, therefore a Fanatic that moves into contact with a row of defensive stakes, from any direction, comes to a very sudden stop and is removed from play as a casualty.
faq.source: Official Ravening Hordes FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: Do runes inscribed upon a doomseekers whirling blades of death apply to?
faq.bodyIndex: Yes. As stated under Whirlwind of Death, Impact Hits caused by a Doomseeker are resolved using the profile of its whirling blades of death, which includes any runes the weapon is inscribed with.
faq.source: Official Forces of Fantasy FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: Whilst drain magic is in play does it increase the casting value of bound spells?
faq.bodyIndex: Yes.
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: If the musician and or standard bearer in a unit of slayers are models that?
faq.bodyIndex: It rather depends on the models that remain in the unit. If any Giant Slayers remain, they will pick up the instrument or standard, replacing the slain models like for like. If no Giant Slayers remain, a Troll Slayer will take their place. Note also that Giant Slayers are not unit champions. Thus in a unit of Slayers, the standard bearer would be the last model removed.
faq.source: Official Forces of Fantasy FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: Does a unit of battle pilgrims that includes a grail reliquae benefit from blessings of the lady or just the grail reliquae itself?
faq.bodyIndex: If the unit includes a Grail Reliquae, the entire unit gains Blessings of the Lady.
faq.source: Official Forces of Fantasy FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: Are the effects of the casket of souls bound spell light of protection?
faq.bodyIndex: No.
faq.source: Official Ravening Hordes FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: Are unsaved wounds caused by the mount of a model bearing the laurels of?
faq.bodyIndex: No, only unsaved wounds caused by the bearer (the rider) count.
faq.source: Official Forces of Fantasy FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: What happens to a fanatic that ends its movement within the command range of?
faq.bodyIndex: The Fanatic must make a Dangerous Terrain test. Rather than creating an area of dangerous terrain, Hostile Terrain represents a model laying traps and creating hazards, causing enemy models to make a dangerous terrain test should they end their movement within that area.
faq.source: Official Ravening Hordes FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: Can a cannon be shot in such a way as to hit an enemy unit that is engaged?
faq.bodyIndex: No. Page 143 of the rulebook makes it clear that, except in rare cases, units cannot shoot enemy units that are engaged in combat. In the case of cannon, this means the target point cannot be placed in such a way as to risk the cannonball hitting a friendly unit, or an enemy unit engaged in combat with a friendly unit.
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: When a character takes a chariot as a mount do they replace one of the crew?
faq.bodyIndex: No. The points you pay for a chariot include its crew, whether that chariot is included in your army on its own or as a mount for a character. However, in reality it might prove difficult to fit a character and the full complement of crew into the chariot model itself. If so, it is perfectly acceptable to remove one or more of the crew models to make space for the character. In such cases, we can think of the missing crew model's profile(s) as a way of representing that the beasts pulling a character's chariot are bound to be bigger, stronger and better trained than normal.
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: If a model has armour bane x listed amongst its special rules i e if the?
faq.bodyIndex: Yes.
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: If a unit with the press of battle rule has not yet fought models from the end of the first fighting rank will close in as described on page 150 into base contact with the enemy but can models from the second fighting rank step forward into base contact?
faq.bodyIndex: Yes. As stated on page 150, models cannot fight during a phase in which they stepped forward into a fighting rank. However, models already in a fighting rank can step forward and close in as described, maximising their number of Attacks.
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: Models cannot cast magic missiles or magical vortexes after marching but?
faq.bodyIndex: Yes.
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: If a wizard has a magic item or special rule that allows them to re roll a?
faq.bodyIndex: No. A roll of a natural double 1 isn't merely a failed Casting roll, it is a Miscast, as described on page 109.
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: What happens if a scatter roll causes any part of an object to cross beyond?
faq.bodyIndex: The object is removed from play.
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: Can a troll hag be the general of an orc and goblin tribes army made using?
faq.bodyIndex: No. A Troll Hag is a Rare choice in the Orc and Goblin Tribes Grand Army composition list. She can, however, be the General of a Troll Horde.
faq.source: Official Ravening Hordes FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: Does a magic standard that affects a units weapons the razor standard for?
faq.bodyIndex: Not unless the description of the magic standard in question states that the weapons of a unit carrying it gain the Magical Attacks special rule. Generally speaking, purchasing a magic item doesn't conjure up additional bonuses from the æther.
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: Can the spell spectral doppelganger from the lore of illusion be used with a?
faq.bodyIndex: No. Weapons limited to a single attack can only inflict a single hit.
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: Can a doomseeker join a unit of slayers?
faq.bodyIndex: No, as per the errata, a Doomseeker is not a character. They are loners and outcasts even amongst Slayers and, as such, act as a unit of one model.
faq.source: Official Forces of Fantasy FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: Do the points i spend on core units within an allied contingent count?
faq.bodyIndex: No.
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: Two characters are engaged in a challenge whilst their units battle around?
faq.bodyIndex: Yes. As stated on page 211, if both participants in a challenge survive the round and if the combat continues, the challenge continues.
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: Is a units maximum possible charge range the maximum distance from an enemy unit at which it can dec?
faq.bodyIndex: It is the maximum distance from an enemy unit at which it can declare a charge.
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: Do skirmishers have flank or rear arcs whilst engaged in combat?
faq.bodyIndex: Whilst Skirmishers do form up when engaged in combat, they are not considered to have flank or rear arcs for the purposes of calculating combat result points.
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: Does press of battle apply to a units flank and rear arcs or just to its front arc?
faq.bodyIndex: If a unit has and is able to use the Press of Battle rule, it can do so regardless of which of its arcs the enemy is engaged with.
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: Can a casket of souls move at the end of the shooting phase of its turn?
faq.bodyIndex: No.
faq.source: Official Ravening Hordes FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: How does the spectral doppelganger spell interact with weapons that have?
faq.bodyIndex: The spell is cast at the Wizard's Initiative, meaning attacks generated by the spell are made at the Wizard's Initiative. However, if the casting Wizard wishes to use a weapon with the Strike Last special rule, those attacks are made at Initiative 1.
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: When a unit performs a manoeuvre can its front edge pass through another unit?
faq.bodyIndex: No. The only exception to this is when a unit pivots.
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: When a goblin hewer shoots using the whirling death special rule does it add?
faq.bodyIndex: Roll an Artillery dice, plus an extra D3 per rank or file of the unit, depending upon which arc the weapon is shooting into.
faq.source: Official Forces of Fantasy FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: Can any type of cannon fire grapeshot?
faq.bodyIndex: Only cannons or weapons that fire using the 'Cannon Fire' special rule may also fire 'Grapeshot', as described on page 227 of the Warhammer: The Old World rulebook. This is in addition to any other special rules or additional modes of fire the weapon may have.
faq.source: Online Rules Index Interpretation & Official Forces of Fantasy FAQ & Errata - Version 1.1

faq.name: Some mounted models have the counter charge special rule but others do not even though they have the?
faq.bodyIndex: Yes. Counter Charge is a rule that represents the skill and ferocity of the rider, not their mount. In other words, not every rider is willing or able to perform a counter charge, regardless of their mount.
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: If a troll hag purchases a magic weapon are any of its special rules?
faq.bodyIndex: No. If she attacks normally, she can use her magic weapon. If she makes a Motherly Love attack, she does not use her magic weapon.
faq.source: Official Ravening Hordes FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: If i upgrade a unit of boar boyz to be big uns do their war boars benefit as?
faq.bodyIndex: Yes. Note that the Strength characteristic of Big 'Uns is modified whilst they are engaged in combat, and that Impact Hits are made using the model's unmodified Strength characteristic.
faq.source: Official Ravening Hordes FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: If a model is required to make a leadership test using its own leadership?
faq.bodyIndex: No. When the rules state a model must make a Leadership test using its own Leadership, it must use its own Leadership.
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: If a spell has two casting values do i have to say which im attempting to?
faq.bodyIndex: No, your casting result determines the 'strength' of the spell. In other words, the higher your casting result, the more power the spell will have and the greater its effect will be.
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: A character mounted on a ridden monster or a chariot can choose to use their?
faq.bodyIndex: No. You must use a magic item fully or not at all.
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: Does a spell cast on a regimental unit affect its detachments or vice versa?
faq.bodyIndex: No, spells that affect a unit only affect the unit they are cast on.
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: Can the wearer of the wizarding hat cast spells whilst wearing armour?
faq.bodyIndex: Yes. The wearer of the Wizarding Hat is not actually a Wizard – their magical powers are granted by a haunted hat which is not affected by any armour the model may wear.
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: What happens if a unit in lance formation that declares a charge finds its?
faq.bodyIndex: Such situations are covered by the rules for Accidental Contact During a Charge. If the Lance can wheel around the enemy unit, it should do so. If not, the Lance has two choices; halting its charge or continuing ahead and making contact with the enemy unit, treating it as a redirected charge.
faq.source: Official Forces of Fantasy FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: If a unit bearing a standard inscribed with the master rune of hesitation?
faq.bodyIndex: Yes. When a pursuing unit catches an enemy unit that Fell Back in Good Order, it counts as having charged that unit.
faq.source: Official Forces of Fantasy FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: If a model bearing the laurels of victory stands and shoots as a charge?
faq.bodyIndex: No.
faq.source: Official Forces of Fantasy FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: Can a unit that is partially on a hill shoot in two ranks?
faq.bodyIndex: No. To claim the benefits of being on a hill, a unit must be entirely on the hill.
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: If a character is within one fighting rank they cannot move through the ranks to join another might this prevent them from accepting a challenge?
faq.bodyIndex: No. If a character is eligible to accept a challenge they can do so wherever they are in a unit and will move through the ranks into base contact with their opponent. However, if it is awkward to move a model, it is quite acceptable for the players to agree it has moved and fight the challenge as if the combatants were in base contact, thus avoiding too much disruption.
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: When a unit of skirmishers becomes engaged in combat and forms up must any command group models it contains be placed in the fighting rank?
faq.bodyIndex: Yes.
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: When a unit wheels is it acceptable for a rear corner to pass through another unit?
faq.bodyIndex: Yes, provided the unit does not end its movement 'on top' of another unit or within 1" of an enemy unit.
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: Is it possible to resurrect models in a unit of skirmishers?
faq.bodyIndex: Yes, simply place the resurrected models in coherency (i.e., within 1" of another model) with the rest of the unit.
faq.source: Official Ravening Hordes FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: Does the griffon standard allow a unit to claim a higher rank bonus than?
faq.bodyIndex: Yes. As stated in the item's rules, a unit carrying the Griffon Standard can claim a Rank Bonus of +2 for each extra rank behind the first, rather than the usual +1, meaning a unit with two extra ranks could claim a Rank Bonus of +4, rather than the usual +2.
faq.source: Official Forces of Fantasy FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: If a unit of enemy infantry charges a unit with the master rune of?
faq.bodyIndex: No. Although the Rune prevents a charging enemy unit from using certain weapons or special rules, the unit has still charged, and thus cannot make use of the Press of Battle rule.
faq.source: Official Forces of Fantasy FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: Can the wearer of the wizarding hat also wear a magic helmet such as the bedazzling helm?
faq.bodyIndex: Yes, because one is an enchanted item, the other is a type of magic armour, but we hope anyone equipping a model in such a way would make the effort to depict it wearing two hats!
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: Can a war machine shoot using the ballistic skill of a character that has?
faq.bodyIndex: No. Because a war machine and its crew are treated as a single model, you must use the crew's BS.
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: If i have a character with an armour value of 6 mounted on a chariot with an?
faq.bodyIndex: No, you choose whichever armour value is better. However, allowing for magical armour and other special rules, 'better' is somewhat subjective. Obviously an armour value of 4+ is better than one of 6+ but there is often more to deciding which armour to use than just the armour value it offers, many types of magic armour confer additional bonuses that make them better. Basically, when the rules say 'choose', they are giving you a choice.
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: When a unit counter charges it rolls d3 1 to determine how far it moves is?
faq.bodyIndex: No.
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: How many attacks can a model with a split profile make if it is in the?
faq.bodyIndex: A model with a split profile consists of not one model, but several, all sharing the same base. Therefore, each model on that base could make a single attack. In the case of a cavalry model, for example, this would be one attack from the rider and one from their mount.
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: Can a unit on a hill draw a line of sight across and shoot over another unit on the same hill?
faq.bodyIndex: A unit that is closer to the top of a hill (i.e., the centre of the hill or the edge of the battlefield) can draw a line of sight across and shoot over one that is closer to the bottom. Units cannot draw a line of sight across or shoot over units that are closer to the top of a hill than they are.
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: If a remains in play spell with two casting values is cast at the higher?
faq.bodyIndex: As stated on page 111, in order to dispel a Remains in Play spell during your Conjuration sub-phase, you must beat the minimum casting value given in the spell's description. This is the case even if the spell was cast at the higher of two given casting values.
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: When shooting a doom diver catapult the template can be moved d3 after?
faq.bodyIndex: Yes. The template must be moved the full distance rolled on the D3 but, if that allows you to position it to hit an enemy character, you may do so. Sneaky Goblin Doom Divers steer their flight in an attempt to hit the best possible target, so this is completely in character.
faq.source: Official Ravening Hordes FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: Can the size of a range self spells aura of effect be increased by the idol?
faq.bodyIndex: No. The aura of effect of a range 'self' spell is not its range.
faq.source: Official Ravening Hordes FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: Some single use special rules and magic items require a leadership test to?
faq.bodyIndex: Yes.
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: How does a bolt thrower work when shooting at a unit in lance formation?
faq.bodyIndex: The number of models hit is based on the number of ranks overall. For example, a Lance of six knights (arranged in ranks  of one, two and three models) would suffer three hits. When a Lance is shot in its flank by a bolt thrower, the number of hits is based on the widest file. To continue the example above, three models would be hit based on the depth of the unit.
faq.source: Official Forces of Fantasy FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: If a unit of enemy infantry charges a unit with the master rune of initiative?
faq.bodyIndex: Yes. The Master Rune of Hesitation only prevents the use of certain weapons and special rules.
faq.source: Official Forces of Fantasy FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: My unit charges an enemy unit that is defending a low linear obstacle making?
faq.bodyIndex: No. Whilst a charging unit will become disordered, and whilst Impact Hits and Stomp Attacks cannot be made due to the presence of the obstacle (as stated above), units are otherwise able to fight normally across a low linear obstacle, as if they were in base contact.
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: Some war machines can have additional models attached to them such as the?
faq.bodyIndex: Yes.
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: Is there a maximum beyond which characteristics cannot be modified?
faq.bodyIndex: Unless a rule specifies a maximum, no.
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: If a character whose mount has a different sized base to the models in a?
faq.bodyIndex: The Lance formation offers a bit more flexibility than other formations. For example, it is perfectly acceptable to place a character such as a Duke or a Baron at the front of the Lance should you wish. In the case of a Handmaiden of the Lady, the Shield of the Lady special rule allows such models to be placed  at the rear of such units. Alternatively, they can be placed within the unit. In this case, the extra base size will make very little difference to the shape of the unit.
faq.source: Official Forces of Fantasy FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: If a wizard wears the wizarding hat does it increase their level of wizardry?
faq.bodyIndex: No. As stated in the item's description, the wearer of the Wizarding Hat is a Level 1 Wizard and knows one randomly generated spell. This is clearly a huge detriment to a powerful Wizard, but might be a boon to any character that is not a Wizard.
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: If a unit charged by two or more enemy units counter charges one of them it?
faq.bodyIndex: Yes. When a unit Counter Charges, it risks exposing its flanks or rear to the enemy, such are the perils of bravado.
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: Some chariots are equipped with large scale missile weapons such as bolt?
faq.bodyIndex: Missile weapons mounted on chariots (or howdahs) are shot by the crew, using their Ballistic Skill.
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: When a unit wheels do you have to measure the curvature of its movement?
faq.bodyIndex: No, simply measure the unit’s movement in a straight line from the end of the front rank furthest from the corner around which the unit pivots.
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: All goblins fear elves if a unit of elves causes fear does this lead them to?
faq.bodyIndex: No.
faq.source: Official Ravening Hordes FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: If a character mounted on a ridden monster or chariot carries a shield does?
faq.bodyIndex: No, a shield is carried by the character, not the mount.
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: How many remains in play spells can i attempt to dispel during my?
faq.bodyIndex: As many as you wish, or, perhaps more accurately, as many as your opponent has in play and as many as you are able.
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: Does the presence in a unit of a character whose base takes up the space of?
faq.bodyIndex: No.
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: Can a drilled unit redress the ranks before making a counter charge charge reaction?
faq.bodyIndex: Yes.
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: When a unit in lance formation is engaged in combat every model on the?
faq.bodyIndex: Every model within the first fighting rank that is within a number of inches equal to its Movement characteristic of the Lance. In the case of enemy regular or heavy infantry, the second fighting rank is not in base contact – there is another rank in the way. When a Lance charges, it pierces deep into the enemy formation, pushing warriors back and causing the enemy lines to close around it. It’s very hard to show this on the table though, hence the abstraction. Note that this can create an area of ‘dead ground’ between a Lance and a unit it is engaged in combat with. If any enemy units are caught within this, refer to the rules covering ‘accidental contact’ on page 131 of the Warhammer: the Old World rulebook.
faq.source: Official Forces of Fantasy FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: Do potions affect a models mount?
faq.bodyIndex: No.
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: Can the glowy green amulet be used by a character that isnt a wizard?
faq.bodyIndex: Yes. The Glowy Green Amulet is a talisman, meaning any character that can take magic items can take it. However, if they wish to use it against an enemy spell, they do so instead of a Wizardly dispel attempt being made. This means that you cannot also attempt a Wizardly dispel against a spell you use the Glowy Green Amulet against, even if the Glowy Green Amulet explodes.
faq.source: Official Ravening Hordes FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: If a unit will have to wheel before or during a charge do i have to allow?
faq.bodyIndex: Yes. Wheeling during a charge is part of the charge move. The free wheel to align once contact is made is free.
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: What happens to a remains in play spell that is already in effect if the wizard that cast it attempt?
faq.bodyIndex: It ends immediately.
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: Can a close order unit of just one model claim the close order combat result?
faq.bodyIndex: Yes, provided it has a high enough Unit Strength (as per the errata on page 1). A unit of just one model is still a unit.
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: Can a unit arrayed in close order or open order formation be one model wide?
faq.bodyIndex: Yes.
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: If some of my opponents attacks cause multiple wounds to be lost per unsaved?
faq.bodyIndex: Apply unsaved wounds to a unit one at a time and one model at a time. When a model is reduced to zero Wounds on its profile, it is removed from play as a casualty (as described on page 102). If a model loses more Wounds than it has on its profile, the excess wounds are lost – they do not spill over onto other models in the same unit. With this in mind, apply unsaved wounds that cause models to lose all of their remaining Wounds first (Killing Blows and Monster Slaying Blows, for example), then unsaved wounds that cause multiple Wounds to be lost (Multiple Wounds (X), for example), then, finally, unsaved wounds that cause a single Wound to be lost.
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: Is a charging lance blunted if an enemy unit counter charges it?
faq.bodyIndex: No. As both units are charging, the clause that a Lance is blunted if it is charged and does not counter charge is negated.
faq.source: Official Forces of Fantasy FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: If the scroll of transmogrification is successfully used against a wizard mounted on a ridden monste?
faq.bodyIndex: The Wizard is transmogrified, but not their mount. In the example given, you would be left with a Frog riding a Dragon.
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: A clumsy unit cannot be joined by a character that is not also clumsy but?
faq.bodyIndex: Yes.
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: What happens to a unit that gives ground whilst within 2 of the edge of the battlefield?
faq.bodyIndex: Should any part of a unit cross beyond the edge of the battlefield whilst it is Giving Ground, the entire unit is removed from play and counts as having been destroyed.
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: Can a model wearing armour or carrying a shield cast a bound spell?
faq.bodyIndex: Yes.
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: If a unit whose troop type is infantry that has been joined by a character?
faq.bodyIndex: No. A unit's troop type doesn't change when joined by a character.
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: When a unit redresses the ranks must the width of its front rank be increased or decreased as equally as possible on either side?
faq.bodyIndex: Yes. The exception to this is when the width of the front rank is increased or decreased by an odd number of models. In such cases, one side of the unit will gain or lose one more model than the other side.
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: What happens if a scroll of transmogrification is used on a bound spell?
faq.bodyIndex: After testing against the item's Power Level (in place of its Level of Wizardry), it may be turned into an inanimate frog, rendering it useless until it turns back. During each Start of Turn sub-phase, you may roll a D6 for each transmogrified item in your army to see if it returns to normal, as described on page 343.
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: Can a unit with the finest warhorses special rule re roll the dice when?
faq.bodyIndex: No. Finest Warhorses allows a unit to re-roll its Charge roll, but the D6 rolled when using Swiftstride is not part of the charge roll; it is rolled to give a modifier to the result of the Charge roll.
faq.source: Official Forces of Fantasy FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: Does a unit that is joined by a character of a different troop type gain the?
faq.bodyIndex: No.
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: How far does a model with the random movement special rule move when making?
faq.bodyIndex: As stated in the Counter Charge special rule, a model that makes a Counter Charge moves D3+1".
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: What happens to a unit that cannot give ground due to the presence of another unit?
faq.bodyIndex: The unit's movement stops immediately, as if it were surrounded.
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: Does a unit that has to declare a charge due to being frenzied or impetuous?
faq.bodyIndex: If there is a chance of the Skirmishers moving so that they are no longer an obstruction (if they declare a charge, for example), yes. Otherwise, no.
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: Can a wizard attempt to dispel a bound spell by attempting a wizardly dispel?
faq.bodyIndex: If the Wizard is within range of the model casting the Bound spell and not otherwise prevented from attempting a Wizardly dispel, yes. As stated on page 109, you may attempt to dispel a Bound spell as usual.
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: Can models choose not to make armour ward or regeneration saves if it has them?
faq.bodyIndex: No. If a model can attempt to make a save, it must.
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: Can a wizard with a physical attribute that counts as a type of armour such?
faq.bodyIndex: Yes. Whilst such attributes are as protective as a suit of armour, such models do not wear armour.
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: Can a wizard with a lore familiar choose one of their factions signature?
faq.bodyIndex: No.
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: Can a character who is within the fighting rank of their unit but not in?
faq.bodyIndex: No. Characters can move through the ranks into the fighting rank, but cannot move within the fighting rank.
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: A pursuing unit must move directly towards the fleeing enemy but must it move forwards whilst doing so or can it move sideways?
faq.bodyIndex: As stated on page 123, units must move forwards unless performing a manoeuvre (or when Giving Ground). This includes whilst pursuing.
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: Although it cannot make a charge move a unit in marching column can declare?
faq.bodyIndex: There are several reasons. Firstly, a Drilled unit that declares a charge whilst in Marching Column can freely redress its ranks to adopt Combat Order after determining its charge range, but before moving, thus allowing it to make a charge move. Secondly, units that are obliged to declare a charge in certain circumstances (those that are Frenzied or Impetuous, for example) must do so even whilst in Marching Column. If they cannot make the charge move, they don't move at all and the charge is failed. This prevents Marching Column being used to avoid declaring compulsory charges. Alternatively, there might be a psychological advantage to declaring a charge with a Marching Column. For example, the unit might cause Terror, or the charge target might already be fleeing. Of course, it isn't easy to set up situations where such tactics can be used and therein lies the challenge.
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: If a unit with the press of battle rule has two fighting ranks can i remove?
faq.bodyIndex: No. Models in the first fighting rank, the rank in base contact with the enemy, fall first as casualties.
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: Can a drilled unit redress the ranks before giving ground?
faq.bodyIndex: Yes. A unit that Gives Ground is not a fleeing unit. Note that, as mentioned previously, should any part of a unit cross beyond the edge of the battlefield whilst it is Giving Ground, the entire unit is removed from play and counts as having been destroyed. It is intentional that a Drilled unit might be able to avoid this fate.
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: How many spells does a wizard with an arcane familiar know for example does?
faq.bodyIndex: An Arcane Familiar does not increase the number of spells a Wizard knows, it simply allows them to know spells from two Lores. Thus a Level 3 Wizard would know three spells from two Lores.
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: If a unit has to pivot before fleeing from an enemy it is engaged in combat with must it make peril tests?
faq.bodyIndex: No. As stated on page 125, units ignore other units whilst pivoting.
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: Can an evasive unit use that special rule whilst engaged in combat?
faq.bodyIndex: No.
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: If a unit contains models of two different troop types how do i determine?
faq.bodyIndex: In such cases, the troop type of the majority of the models determines the unit’s maximum rank bonus.
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: Can a character be placed amongst a units command group?
faq.bodyIndex: Yes.
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: If a drilled unit in marching column has to declare a charge due to being?
faq.bodyIndex: If it is able to redress the ranks (i.e., if there is space for it to do so), no. A unit that is obliged to charge must endeavour to make use of any special rules it has in order to charge. The unit just really wants to charge, and it'll play this game without you if it has to!
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: If a wizard has joined a unit can they cast spells from any rank or must they be in the front rank?
faq.bodyIndex: Unless they have a special rule that states otherwise, a Wizard must be in the front rank (or the first fighting rank) of their unit to cast spells. Like all characters, Wizards bring no benefit to their unit by skulking in the rear ranks.
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: If i want to charge an enemy unit that is a large target with a unit of mine?
faq.bodyIndex: No. Sometimes a charge isn't possible.
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: If there is no space for a character in the front rank of a unit with the?
faq.bodyIndex: No, characters must be placed in the front rank. If this is not possible, they retire to the rear.
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: Some models can be found in one factions army list but can be included in an?
faq.bodyIndex: Models can purchase magic items from the list of common magic items in the Warhammer: the Old World rulebook, or from their own faction's list of magic items. A Dragon Ogre Shaggoth, for example, can purchase items from the common or Beastmen Brayherds magic item lists.
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: Do effects that modify a models movement characteristic also modify how far?
faq.bodyIndex: Yes. If a model has the Fly (X) special rule, the number given in brackets is essentially a second Movement characteristic. Any effect that modifies one will modify both.
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: What happens if a unit that wishes to make a pursuit or overrun move cannot move due to the presence?
faq.bodyIndex: It may happen that it is simply impossible for a pursuing or overrunning unit to move without it ending up 'on top' of another unit. In such cases, the unit does not move, but is considered to have made a pursuit or overrun move.
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: Does a wizard that has joined a unit need to be in base contact with an enemy model to cast an assai?
faq.bodyIndex: They do not need to be in base contact, but they must be in the first fighting rank.
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: How does a close order unit of just one model act is it still a close order?
faq.bodyIndex: A Close Order unit always acts as such, even if it only contains a single model.
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: If a wizard declines a challenge and retires from combat does their unit lose the benefits of any ra?
faq.bodyIndex: Yes.
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: A fighting rank cannot contain more characters than it does rank and file models in the case of a unit with the press of battle rule does this include rank and file models in a second fighting rank?
faq.bodyIndex: No. No single fighting rank can contain more characters than it does rank and file models. It doesn’t matter how many fighting ranks a unit might have.
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: Can a model with two versions of the fly x special rule combine both and fly?
faq.bodyIndex: No. A model that has more than one version of the Fly (X) special rule essentially has two Movement characteristics it can use when flying. Of these, you may use the best.
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: If a unit completely destroys its enemy in combat and makes an overrun move can it attempt to reform?
faq.bodyIndex: Unless it pursued into a fresh enemy, yes. A unit that overruns makes a normal pursuit move and, since its enemy has already been wiped out, it may attempt to reform as if it had run down its foe, as described on page 129.
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: If a single model unit straddles two arcs of an enemy unit it wishes to?
faq.bodyIndex: No, this is only the case when you cannot determine which arc of an enemy unit a charging unit is within. If it is clear that the majority of a charging unit is within one particular arc, even if that unit consists of only one model, it will charge into that arc.
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: Does a unit count as being obscured when some of the models within it are?
faq.bodyIndex: No. A unit cannot be obscured from the enemy by itself. What’s more, models within a unit do not obscure the enemy from other models within the same unit. They either completely block line of sight, or present no obstruction.
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: If a unit with the fly x special rule moves over a magical vortex that counts as dangerous terrain i?
faq.bodyIndex: Yes. Magical vortexes are considered tall enough to affect even models that are flying high above the battlefield.
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: Can characters displace command group models into the second rank of a unit?
faq.bodyIndex: No, command group models must always be in the front rank of their unit.
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: If a unit with the fly x special rule is engaged in combat can it use its?
faq.bodyIndex: No. Models with the Fly (X) special rule only fly whilst moving. In other words, such models are considered to have landed on the ground whilst the fighting takes place, and must use their given Movement characteristic to determine if they are close enough to the enemy to fight.
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: On page 157 it states that units that pursue and catch an enemy that fell?
faq.bodyIndex: Exactly what it says – the pursuing unit counts as having charged its enemy during the next turn of the game, when the combat is fought, even though the unit will not actually have moved during that turn. This means rules and weapons that can only be used by charging models can be used, that Initiative modifiers for charging are granted (based on the distance the unit pursued), and so forth.
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: If a unit charges an enemy that is defending a low linear obstacle can it?
faq.bodyIndex: No. As stated on page 270, the charging unit moves into base contact with the obstacle.
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: Can different saves be combined together to improve their save value for?
faq.bodyIndex: No, values given as a target number cannot be combined to lower the target number. If a model has two or more Ward saves, as per the example, simply use the best.
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: If a model with a split profile has the impact hits x special rule do all?
faq.bodyIndex: No. Impact Hits are only made by a mount, not by its rider(s). In the case of a chariot, Impact Hits are made by the chariot itself, not by the beasts that draw it. If a rider has their own Impact Hits (X) special rule, these are made separately by the rider.
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: If a character is in the back rank of a unit due to there not being enough?
faq.bodyIndex: No, not unless they have a special rule stating otherwise. Characters must lead from the front or retire to the rear.
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: When a unit redirects a charge can it charge a unit that lies beyond its maximum possible charge ran?
faq.bodyIndex: No.
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: Whilst running down the foe is a charging unit considered to be pursuing a fleeing enemy for the purposes of crossing the edge of the battlefield etc?
faq.bodyIndex: Yes, a unit that runs down the foe is very much pursuing a fleeing enemy whilst doing so.
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: If a model has killing blow or monster slayer does a roll to wound of a natural 6 cause an enemy to lose all of its remaining wounds even if that enemy would normally be too tough to wound?
faq.bodyIndex: No. If a model cannot wound an enemy, it cannot kill it.
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: If a warband character as described on page 180 joins a warband with a rank bonus of one or more does?
faq.bodyIndex: Yes.
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: When a unit enters the battle as reinforcements is there a limit to how far onto the battlefield mod?
faq.bodyIndex: Yes. The unit is considered to have moved onto the battlefield. Therefore, no model can be placed more than twice its Movement characteristic from the edge of the battlefield its unit enters from.
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: Impact hits and stomp attacks cannot be directed against a character that?
faq.bodyIndex: Yes. Whilst unit champions are not characters, they function like characters in many ways, and this is one. Impact Hits and Stomp Attacks are indiscriminate, and targeting specific models, like unit champions, is not possible unless there are fewer than five rank and file models in the unit.
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: My unit wishes to shoot at an enemy lone character however an enemy unit?
faq.bodyIndex: Yes. The rule that a lone character cannot be shot at unless they are the closest target only extends to units they are within 3" of. If a unit is more than 3" from the character, it does not protect them, regardless of how close it is to the enemy.
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: If a unit with frenzy or impetuous has two movement characteristics for?
faq.bodyIndex: If it is able to use the greater, then yes, it must (tactically, you might not want it to, but a Frenzied Lord of Chaos on a mighty Dragon doesn't care about your tactics!).
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: Can my unit shoot at an enemy character that is within 3 of an enemy unit if that unit is not itself an eligible target?
faq.bodyIndex: No. If the requirements given on page 206 are met, the character cannot be targeted.
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: Can a wizard cast a conveyance spell during a turn in which they charged?
faq.bodyIndex: No.
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: Can a character that has joined a unit of models of a different troop type?
faq.bodyIndex: Yes. What's more, they don't get a "Look Out, Sir!" save either.
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: If a unit that is subject to frenzy becomes subject to frenzy again does it?
faq.bodyIndex: No. A unit is either Frenzied or it isn't, multiple instances of Frenzy are not cumulative.
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: If a character joins a unit that carries a magic standard do its effects?
faq.bodyIndex: Yes. When a character joins a unit they become part of that unit, so magic standards that affect the unit affect them as well.
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: War beasts and swarms fear models with the flaming attacks special rule do?
faq.bodyIndex: Yes. Even though models that cause Fear are normally immune to it, the rule that Swarms and War beasts Fear models with Flaming Attacks is an exception called out in those troop types' unique rules.
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: If some models in a unit cause fear but others do not do i use the unit?
faq.bodyIndex: Count only the Unit Strength of the models that cause Fear.
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: Can a character that has joined a unit be the target of a spell that would give them a special rule that prevents them from joining a unit ethereal for example?
faq.bodyIndex: No. If casting a spell would cause a situation the rules specifically prohibit, the spell cannot be cast.
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: If a warband character joins a unit that isnt a warband does that units rank?
faq.bodyIndex: No.
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: Units with the motley crew special rule use the armour value of the majority?
faq.bodyIndex: In such cases, use the better armour value (not including the armour value of any characters or champions that have purchased magic items or unique upgrades to improve their armour).
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: Cannon do not directly target enemy models they target a point on the ground how does this work with?
faq.bodyIndex: The purpose of the Targeting Lone Characters rule is to protect characters from enemy shooting, even from shooting that does not follow the usual rules (though it does not protect them from templates). Therefore, and in the spirit of this rule, unless they are the closest target to the cannon, an enemy character that is within 3" of a friendly unit that contains five or more models of the same troop type cannot be struck by a cannonball, even if their base lies directly under the path of the bouncing cannonball. However, if a Lone character's base lies directly underneath the strike point of a cannonball, they are hit.
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: What happens if a unit with the move through cover special rule is joined by?
faq.bodyIndex: Units move at the speed of their slowest model. Therefore, whilst the unit would suffer no penalty for moving through difficult or dangerous terrain, the character would, potentially reducing how far the entire unit can move.
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: Does a unit with move through cover discard the highest dice when making a charge roll if charging through terrain?
faq.bodyIndex: No.
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: Some magic weapons or special rules allow specific models within a unit to?
faq.bodyIndex: No.
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: What happens if a weapon is subject to both the ponderous and quick shot special rules?
faq.bodyIndex: The rules effectively cancel one another out, meaning the weapon would suffer a -1 To Hit modifier for Moving and Shooting.
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: If a named character is equipped with a mundane weapon such as a lance or cavalry spear and a magic?
faq.bodyIndex: They must use their magic weapon. However, some named characters will carry a 'back-up' weapon which they can use should their magic weapon be destroyed.
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: Can a unit with the random movement special rule move around or past an?
faq.bodyIndex: No. Whilst units that move randomly do not declare charges, if you wish to move one into contact with an enemy unit, it must fulfil the same criteria as any other charging unit during its movement, as detailed on page 126.
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: Some characters have special abilities that require a leadership test if the character is slain do these abilities cease to apply immediately like a spell?
faq.bodyIndex: Yes.
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: How far does a unit with the random movement special rule move when giving?
faq.bodyIndex: All units move 2" when Giving Ground.
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: Can a model make more regeneration saves than it has wounds remaining on its profile?
faq.bodyIndex: No. When a model makes Regeneration saves, it makes one save for each Wound lost.
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: Can a unit that deploys using the scouts special rule make a vanguard move?
faq.bodyIndex: No.
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: If a unit of scouts is deployed completely within my deployment zone can they be deployed within 12 of the enemy and can they charge in the first turn?
faq.bodyIndex: No. Regardless of where they are deployed, a unit deployed as Scouts must abide by the rules for deploying as Scouts.
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: Are units that deploy using the scouts special rule counted when determining?
faq.bodyIndex: Yes.
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: If a model with a split profile has the stomp attacks x special rule do all?
faq.bodyIndex: No. Stomp attacks are only made by a mount, not by its rider(s). In the case of a chariot, Stomp Attacks are made by the beasts that draw it or, if there are no beasts, by the chariot itself.
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: If a stubborn character joins a unit that is not stubborn and that unit loses its first combat of the game does the character remain stubborn until they have an opportunity to make use of the rule later on?
faq.bodyIndex: No. Stubborn is used the first time a unit loses combat. If a character is unable to use the rule due to being part of a unit that is not Stubborn, the opportunity is lost.
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: When a unit that does not have the stupidity special rule is joined by a character that does the uni?
faq.bodyIndex: The unit ceases to be subject to Stupidity the moment the character leaves the unit.
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: Swiftstride enables a model to move further during a charge move than its?
faq.bodyIndex: Because models with this special rule delight in running down cowards who flee before a charge!
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: Do models that cause terror cause it in models that cause fear?
faq.bodyIndex: No. Models that cause Terror cause Fear in models with the Fear special rule, even though such models are normally immune to Fear.
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: If the winning side of a combat includes one or more models that cause?
faq.bodyIndex: No. Because models that cause Fear or Terror aren't terrified by Terror causing enemies, they do not suffer the effects of Terror.
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: Are wounds lost as a result of a model with timmm berrr falling on a unit?
faq.bodyIndex: Yes.
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: If a character without the vanguard special rule joins a unit with it during deployment can the char?
faq.bodyIndex: No. What’s more, if the unit is formed, it will not be able to make a Vanguard move; the presence of a character without the Vanguard special rule within its ranks prevents it. However, if the unit is in Skirmish formation, it can make its Vanguard move as normal, leaving the character behind.
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3

faq.name: Can a character without the veteran special rule that has joined a unit with the veteran special rul?
faq.bodyIndex: No. When a character attempts to use a special rule that requires them to make a Leadership test, they must use their own Leadership characteristic and, unless specifically stated otherwise, cannot use any additional special rules they themselves do not have.
faq.source: Official Warhammer: The Old World FAQ & Errata - Version 1.5.3
